About

Results-driven analytical professional who loves to bridge the gap between raw operational data and strategic decisions — building pipelines, models, and dashboards that drive real impact.

My work spans demand forecasting, supplier quality analytics, last-mile delivery optimization, and ML-powered process improvement. I've shipped data solutions at Amazon, Tesla, FedEx and Veerabhadra Agencies that reduced costs, improved quality, and accelerated impact.

Passionate about utilizing predictive analytics, automated workflows and AI tools to solve intricate operational challenges and scale business performance in fast-paced, technology-driven environments.

Dynamic Safety Stock Optimization

Replaced static inventory formulas by integrating Random Forest models for demand and lead time variability prediction with Linear Programming for optimized stock allocation across 3,000+ SKU-store combinations — achieving a 15% reduction in inventory holding costs. Machine learning and statistical approach in modeling and optimization of surface roughness in wire electrical discharge machining

Applied NN, SVM, and Genetic Algorithm to predict and optimize surface roughness in WEDM of Inconel 718. SVM achieved near-perfect accuracy (R = 0.99999, MAPE = 0.035%) and GA delivered a 61% improvement in surface finish over experimental results.

Materials and Manufacturing Processes DOI ↗

Estimation of machinability performance in wire-EDM on titanium alloy using neural networks

Built a multi-output NN model (8-5-5-4 architecture) to simultaneously predict surface roughness, cutting speed, kerf width, and MRR in WEDM of Ti-6Al-4V alloy, achieving a correlation of R = 0.9995 across all four outputs.

Modeling of tool wear in machining of AISI 52100 steel using artificial neural networks

Developed a NN model to predict cutting tool flank wear across three lubrication environments — dry, wet, and MQL machining — with R-values close to 1 in all conditions, establishing MQL as the optimal setup for minimizing tool wear.
